name: Ascension Ep. 1
description:
O.W.L. officially takes flight with the premiere episode of Ascension—and the beginning of a new partnership with NOTFLIX. Parliament Hall receives a special takeover inspired by NOTFLIX’s hit series Things Are Strange, with themed arena and ring graphics setting the stage for an unforgettable first night.

More importantly, the Inaugural Championship Series begins. Willow Nightingale faces Bayley in our main event, Speedball Mike Bailey meets Blackheart Lio Rush, Giulia takes on Katsumi Nanami, and more as the first competitors begin their climb toward championship gold at Blood on the Sand.

New home. New era. No boundaries.

Ascension starts here.

name: Revolt Ep. 1
description:
Revolt erupts onto the OWL schedule with a debut episode built to make an immediate impression. The new brand takes over Parliament Hall for its first night of action, introducing its roster, rivalries and volatile identity in front of a crowd with no idea what to expect next.

Making the premiere even stranger, **Notflix** invades the broadcast for a special crossover with its hit series **Guid Squames**. The twisted competition phenomenon spills into OWL, bringing its colorful imagery, bizarre challenges and win-or-lose mentality into the world of professional wrestling. Throughout the night, elements of Guid Squames will collide with Revolt’s matches and personalities, giving the premiere a spectacle unlike any ordinary weekly show.

For Revolt, however, the games are secondary. Championships, rankings and reputations begin here—and everyone on the roster wants to make sure their name is remembered when the first episode ends.
